verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent through per-chat sessions and a composer. The agent carries out git and GitHub operations (clone, branch, commit, push, PRs) and tool calls on the user's behalf, which amounts to operating the product through conversational commands. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that commands are given in natural language (it is only implied by the chat/composer framing), no examples of natural-language control over the app itself (settings, model choice), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
